DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological Jaundice in a 5-day-old breastfed infant.

The onset of jaundice starting on day 5 in a full-term infant with exclusive breastfeeding and no signs of dehydration or abnormal stooling is consistent with late-onset physiological jaundice. I will now check your bilirubin levels to confirm the severity.
